dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: Ah... well. My assignment away from home is almost over, and our wedding anniversary is coming up.

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: But I still haven't picked out a gift for my wife. I'm worried she won't like what I choose and will force a smile anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: Or worse... What if she accepts it coldly, and then takes it as a sign that I never cared to understand her tastes at all?

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: That's why I can't afford to be careless about this. I need to choose something I know that she'll love for sure!
